Title: DA-1 Scaffold Design Arena app skeleton (backend + frontend)
Description: Self-contained repo: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy backend (SQLite default), Vite/React/TS/Tailwind frontend, Makefile, README, env template. Backend serves built SPA in prod.

Title: DA-2 Data model for arena battles and votes
Description: ORM schema: users, arena_models, battles, generations, matches, votes, rating_snapshots, model_ratings. Votes append-only with synthetic flag; anonymity enforced at serialization.

Title: DA-3 Passwordless auth (email codes) with placeholder email delivery
Description: Request-code/verify endpoints, 15-min single-use codes, HMAC-signed stdlib session tokens (cookie + bearer), /me, logout. Dev mode surfaces the code in the UI; EMAIL_PROVIDER_API_KEY placeholder.

Title: DA-4 Offline sample generation provider with model personas
Description: 14 design personas x 6 category template families (website, UI component, SVG dataviz, playable canvas game, SVG logo, ASCII art). Deterministic per (model, prompt, category), prompt-keyword aware.

Title: DA-5 Live vendor adapters behind placeholder keys
Description: Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/OpenRouter adapters (httpx, shared category system prompts) routed by DESIGNARENA_GENERATION_MODE=live; fail fast with ProviderNotConfigured while keys are placeholders.

Title: DA-6 Battle orchestration + tournament state machine
Description: Random 4-model selection, async generation fan-out, shuffled anonymous slots, semi1/semi2 -> final/third bracket with server-enforced vote order, vote rows per pairwise choice, reveal on completion.

Title: DA-7 Bradley-Terry ratings engine
Description: MM fit over pairwise votes, smoothing for undefeated models, Elo-style display scale (1200 anchor, 400/decade), bootstrap 95% CIs. Unit-tested.

Title: DA-8 Leaderboard snapshot pipeline (batch + live triggers)
Description: Materialized snapshots per category + overall; CLI batch job, background recompute on battle completion, API reads latest snapshot only. Verified live: completed battle moved website board 500->504 votes.

Title: DA-9 Seed pipeline: model roster + synthetic bootstrap votes
Description: 14-model roster with latent per-category strengths; ~3k BT-distributed synthetic votes (flagged) so the board is credible on day one; --reset to regenerate.

Title: DA-10 Frontend: prompt -> vote -> reveal core loop
Description: Landing (category chips, examples, champions teaser), battle page with side-by-side sandboxed interactive previews, vote buttons + arrow keys, progress dots, podium reveal.

Title: DA-11 Frontend: leaderboard, login, history
Description: Leaderboard with category tabs/score bars/CIs/win rates; email-code login flow with dev-code surface; My battles history with resume-voting and winners.

Title: DA-12 Test suite + browser QA
Description: 10 backend tests (ratings math, API flow, bracket order, auth gating, leaderboard freshness); Playwright run through the full real-browser flow; game-template polish fixes.

Title: DA-13 Swap in real provider keys and smoke-test live generation
Description: Replace PLACEHOLDER_* keys, set DESIGNARENA_GENERATION_MODE=live, verify each adapter against real endpoints, tune category system prompts on real outputs.

Title: DA-14 Wire transactional email for login codes
Description: Integrate Resend/SendGrid behind EMAIL_PROVIDER_API_KEY, set DESIGNARENA_DEV_LOGIN_CODE=0, add resend-code UX and basic rate limiting.

Title: DA-15 Async generation UX for live mode
Description: Battle POST returns in generating status; worker fills generations; frontend polls/SSE with per-slot skeletons and failure/retry states.

Title: DA-16 Production hardening pass
Description: Real DESIGNARENA_SECRET_KEY, Postgres, Alembic migrations, admin-guard the recompute endpoint, restrict CORS, schedule the batch ratings job.

Title: DA-17 Vote integrity & synthetic decay
Description: Per-user rate limits, anomaly filters at pipeline read time, scheduled down-weighting/aging of synthetic votes as human volume grows.

Title: DA-18 Tie votes and tiebreaker match
Description: Both-good/both-bad options per pairwise, optional 5th tiebreaker match; extend vote schema with outcome type and teach the BT fit ties.

Title: DA-19 Share pages and winners gallery
Description: Public read-only battle page (prompt, bracket, revealed designs), OG images, gallery of recent champions by category.

Title: DA-20 New-model onboarding flow
Description: Admin path to add a roster model: provisional rating, min-vote threshold before listing, active/inactive toggles in an admin UI.

Title: DA-21 Design fidelity pass v2 (match designarena.ai closer)
Description: Generating intro phase, icon category grid, stats row, bracket visualization, leaderboard podium + movement deltas + methodology, fullscreen expand, typography, brand-name extraction, website/chart/logo variants.

Title: BS-1 Vertical + scenario taxonomy (Legal, Finance/ERP)
Description: Two accountability-filtered verticals, four task types, synthetic scenario library with structured facts (planted issues, expected postings, mapping keys).

Title: BS-2 Professional work-product generator with quality tiers
Description: Offline generator drafting redlines, risk memos, journal entries, CoA mappings as paper-styled HTML; latent per-model quality changes substance; deterministic per (model, scenario).

Title: BS-3 Calibration traps (gold-standard checks)
Description: Hidden comparison vs deliberately broken artifact per session; trap_results score the rater, never the models; positions/slots shuffled.

Title: BS-4 Credential tiers + weighted verified boards
Description: Tier from email domain; votes carry weight + server-side decision_ms; timing floor; weighted Bradley-Terry; published snapshots use counted weight>=1 votes only.

Title: BS-5 Reviewer record (the reviewer's payoff)
Description: Calibration score, consensus agreement, percentile, badge ladder, tier explanation - the what's-in-it-for-the-reviewer loop.

Title: BS-6 Frontend pivot
Description: Repositioned home, vertical/task/scenario picker, onboarding modal, 5-comparison judging UI, reveal with calibration card, vertical-grouped leaderboard, profile page.

Title: BS-7 Tests + browser QA for the pivot
Description: 15 backend tests; Playwright run through the full new flow with screenshot review.

Title: BS-8 Describe-don't-disclose scenario synthesis
Description: Synthesize a parallel synthetic document from a user's description - the privacy-preserving BYOD path.

Title: BS-9 License verification integrations
Description: Bar/CPA/SAP cert checks to tier 2; admin flow for named tier-3 reviewers.

Title: BS-10 Rater-level reliability weighting
Description: BT on raters from trap + consensus agreement as continuous vote weight; astroturf pattern detection.

Title: BS-11 Per-firm private arena (the enterprise product)
Description: Firm workspace: their scenarios, named reviewers, private board, benchmark certificate readout.

Title: BS-12 Morning docket
Description: One comparison a day by email; streaks and calibration progress in the digest.

Title: BS-13 Prompt-first front door (pre-signup taste)
Description: Prompt box front door: describe the work -> one blind comparison before signup; signup records the score and continues the session. Pulls describe-don't-disclose forward. No daily-puzzle framing.

Title: BS-14 Medical coding & clinical documentation vertical
Description: E/M coding of clinical notes (ICD-10/CPT keyed), prior-auth appeals, denial responses. Strongest certification culture; half-deterministic scoring; training demand from churn.

Title: BS-15 Tax vertical
Description: Tax memos on positions, return-position review, client letters. Seasonally viral; overlaps finance reviewer base.

Title: BS-16 Company boards + release-drama engine (prototype scope)
Description: Roster kinds foundation|product|declined with provenance + version; vendor products seeded and ranked per vertical; declined vendors as empty-chair FOMO rows with submission CTA; model_releases + simulate endpoint re-running boards with captured rank movement; Release radar UI + home drama banner. 19 tests passing.

Title: BS-18 Company boards production scope
Description: Vendor submission portal (opt-in, terms, versioned resubmission); buyer-contributed outputs under buyer license; real release detection replacing simulate; product re-run cadence; quarterly State-of-vertical report from captured movement.

Title: BS-17 Training & ramp-up mode (L&D SKU)
Description: Judging as deliberate practice for juniors: calibrated curricula, instant trap feedback, manager dashboards; per-seat L&D pricing; trainee votes low-weight until calibrated.
